HEISTY.Settings.ShowAlertMeter.Name: Show the Alert Meter
HEISTY.Settings.ShowAlertMeter.Hint: Display the floating Alert meter HUD. The Storyteller can move the Alert; everyone can see it.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoAlert.Name: Automatic Alert
HEISTY.Settings.AutoAlert.Hint: How roll results move the Alert. Automatic: every roll, creature and spike moves it for you (one event raises it once, by its biggest trigger), and reactions undo it exactly. Propose: each change waits on the Alert meter for your tick. Manual: nothing moves by itself — the 1.7 Alert buttons appear on roll cards, with the suggested one highlighted.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoSilk.Name: Deduct Silk automatically
HEISTY.Settings.AutoSilk.Hint: Silk dice, Rerolls, Clutches, Improvise, Overclock and reactions take their Silk Points off the spider as they're used. Off: costs are shown as advice and nobody's Silk changes unless you change it.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoHits.Name: Hits after a Failure
HEISTY.Settings.AutoHits.Hint: When a spider fails with a threat that can reach them. Ask the Storyteller: the roll card offers you the engaged threats, the strongest first. Automatic: the strongest engaged threat lands its hit once the roll is final. Off: you open attacks yourself from the threat sheet or the card's Hit button.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoVitality.Name: Apply shrug-off results
HEISTY.Settings.AutoVitality.Hint: A shrug-off card changes the spider's Vitality straight away (and rolls That All You Got? when it matters). Off: the card shows the result with an Apply button for you.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoCreatures.Name: Creatures act on their own
HEISTY.Settings.AutoCreatures.Hint: Creatures wake, hunt and spike at their Escalation steps, and each active creature adds its +X to the Alert at the end of every round. Off: you run the creatures from the Heist Tracker by hand.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoClock.Name: Mid-Heist Complication at round 3
HEISTY.Settings.AutoClock.Hint: When the crew starts its third round at one obstacle, the Mid-Heist Complication is rolled and applied for you. Off: use the tracker's Nudge button when you want one.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoStall.Name: Five-round stall prompt
HEISTY.Settings.AutoStall.Hint: After five rounds stuck at one obstacle, you get a one-click prompt to end it (the objective slips away, or the stragglers are caught in the Escape).
HEISTY.Settings.AutoRecovery.Name: Recovery between obstacles
HEISTY.Settings.AutoRecovery.Hint: Each hurt spider recovers one Vitality level in the gap after an obstacle, and you're offered a quiet-round recovery when no threat could reach the crew. Once per obstacle either way.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoWaitingWeb.Name: The Waiting Web
HEISTY.Settings.AutoWaitingWeb.Hint: When a spider goes Out. Automatic: their player is asked for a name (and an optional species swap) and the replacement arrives at the next obstacle, Rattled with half their starting Silk. Ask the Storyteller first: you get a button to bring the replacement in. Off: you handle it yourself.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoCapture.Name: Capture in a Full Alert Escape
HEISTY.Settings.AutoCapture.Hint: In the Escape at Full Alert, a spider who fails a roll is caught (Out) once the roll is final — unless a Clutch or a reroll saves it first.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoFlaws.Name: Flaw Moments and Flaw checks
HEISTY.Settings.AutoFlaws.Hint: Firing a Flaw pays its +1 Silk Point Flaw Moment automatically, and Flaws with a forced check (Fear of Vacuums, Allergic to Dust) get their roll card.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoProcedures.Name: Heist procedures
HEISTY.Settings.AutoProcedures.Hint: The five ready-made heists' own tables and timers (the twin tins, the guard's lap, the librarian's floor, the staff rolls, the water run…) roll themselves when their moment comes and are whispered to you.
HEISTY.Settings.AutoEndRound.Name: End the round
HEISTY.Settings.AutoEndRound.Hint: When every spider still in play has acted. Prompt: you get a one-click End round message. Automatic: the round ends by itself. Off: use End round on the tracker or the Alert meter.
HEISTY.Settings.ForcedRolls.Name: Who rolls forced rolls
HEISTY.Settings.ForcedRolls.Hint: Shrug-offs and Flaw checks. The player rolls: their card gets a button (the Storyteller can always roll it for them). Rolled automatically: they're rolled the moment they're needed.
HEISTY.Settings.TrackerForPlayers.Name: Players see the Heist Tracker
HEISTY.Settings.TrackerForPlayers.Hint: Players can open the tracker to see the phase, the current obstacle and its approaches (with a Roll button), progress, the round, revealed intel, the loot and their own spider. The unknown obstacle and your notes stay hidden.
HEISTY.Settings.MovementWarnings.Name: Movement warnings
HEISTY.Settings.MovementWarnings.Hint: During a combat, warn the mover when a token goes further than its spider's current Speed (carrying loot and Vitality included). It never blocks the move.
